blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–LA Tenorio said he found it odd facing Jimmy Alapag for the first time as PBA coaches when Magnolia beat NLEX, 95-81, in a recent PBA On Tour exhibition game held in Batangas City. Though their first face-off won’t count due to the game being a preparation for the resumption of the Governors’ Cup in October, Tenorio said there’s still a different vibe even though he and Alapag have met multiple times in the past as opposing players. “It’s a weird feeling coaching against him because we always talk, we’re always together and we’ve been very close and we’re family,” […]...
